items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So I said, 'well, I want to latch onto somebody.' I needed the job so I left Arizona with Eli Rice and all the way through with the tours

ctx.x: So when you finished with Lionel Hampton you were going to set out to conquer New York, is that the way it was?

Everybody asked me, said, why don't you go to New York. Go to New York. There's nothing here for you. Go to New York. So I got this little bread from my land in Arizona. I cut out, went to Arizona and didn't get to New York. I left my money with my folks and I got stranded there. And all the bands that came through to play at the Riverside Ballroom in Phoenix, I used to go hear until one time there was a band from Minneapolis by the name of Eli Rice and they heard of my reputation in California, so they said,…
